verdicts.reason: A is cramped. The bottle runs almost from the top edge to the bottom edge. The 'fizz' of the headline crowds into a muddy stack of two overlapping circles in the top-right corner. The body copy is squeezed into a ragged three-line centred block, and the oversized CTA crowds the right edge, so the hierarchy feels jammed. B has a clearer order (logo, headline, one-line subhead, CTA on the right) and fits the banner better, but the bottle is cropped at the bottom edge and pushed into the left corner over the yellow circle, and the CTA is small and floats with an uneven gap.
